name: The Phantom Caller
source:
Andren Freeman is in love with his boss's daughter, Scarlett.Even though he dislikes her spoiled behavior, he is deeply in love with her. But she is not aware of that, and he doesn't have enough courage to confess his love. So, will he able to win her love?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140911115232/http://renai.us/game/phantom_caller.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
